pages.text: $(bold)Smoke Screen$()$(br2)Smoke candles create a temporary smoke screen that blocks line of sight.$(br2)$(bold)Usage:$()$(br)• Throw the smoke candle$(br)• A cloud of smoke appears on impact$(br)• Blocks enemy vision and targeting$(br)• Lasts for a limited duration

$(bold)Flare Launcher$()$(br2)Flares illuminate dark areas and reveal hidden enemies.$(br2)$(bold)Usage:$()$(br)• Launch a flare into the sky$(br)• Illuminates a large area below$(br)• Reveals invisible and hiding entities$(br)• Essential for night operations and submarine detection
